semanticReview.portuguese: Portuguese PNG and resume-editing pages are language-specific equivalents of existing English owners, with separate pt-BR query evidence and reciprocal hreflang. Core synonyms retain one localized core owner. Device/workflow variants remain held.
semanticReview.bankStatements: Extracting selectable transaction tables to XLSX is distinct from assembling bank-statement PDF packets; the recipe explains table-specific row, date and amount checks and does not claim reconciliation.
semanticReview.png: General PNG conversion is distinct from the existing transparent-PNG preset: that preset owns alpha handling and preset behavior. No separate transparent-PNG page is created.
semanticReview.resume: Resume editing changes content; the existing resume compression use case changes file size. No duplicate compression page is created.
semanticReview.landscape: The existing landscape conversion templates concern JPG and DOCX. The new XLSX task reads saved spreadsheet page setup.
semanticReview.whatsapp: Saved chat images need file preparation and ordering guidance. Existing scanned-photo content concerns photographed paper; no integration or direct chat import is claimed.
semanticReview.ocr: Scanned PDF to editable Word is distinct from searchable-PDF OCR and from existing merge/convert workflows.
semanticReview.platform: One Mac page per tool, validated on actual macOS Chrome; aliases and repeated ranking URLs share one owner. Other platform candidates are held.
